about: Examples of the answers of the sync API, reading (lot M4 of docs/adr/0079). Each is taken from the mobile protocol (housecairn-mobile docs/protocol.md) or from the table of routes of docs/adr/0077, with the ids that those documents shorten written out. tests/test_sync_read_contract.py compares the real answers to them field by field: the same keys, values of the same kind. `additions` lists the keys this server gives beyond the examples, each with the rule that asks for it; a client ignores keys it does not know (protocol section 4).

additions.homes[].members: docs/adr/0077 need 9: the members of a home are in GET /sync/homes/ and in the snapshot, with their display name and role, never their address

additions.changes[].device: protocol sections 1 and 2.2: a field is written when (c, device) is greater than its stored clock, so the phone needs the device of each change; on a relay it reads it from the signature of the batch, here the server gives it, 16 bytes in base64url

additions.members line: docs/adr/0077 need 9: {"members": [{"id", "name", "role"}]}, the line before covers

error.source: docs/adr/0077: errors are those of the API today, {"detail": ...}, with a code

examples.detail: This position is older than the oldest change kept: read the snapshot.
